coordinator:
"""Read-only postflight of exact owned PIDs; never terminate a process."""
from pathlib import Path
import datetime
import hashlib
import json
import re
import subprocess

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
folder = ROOT/'docs/testing/performance/0.74/local-runs/cost-phase-readers-20261024'
index = json.loads((folder/'index.json').read_text())
member = index['members']['observation/cost-readers-package-first/owned-cleanup.log']
raw = (ROOT/'target/source-continuation-20261024/cost-readers-package-first/owned-cleanup.log').read_bytes()
assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == member['sha256']
text = raw.decode()
targets = sorted(set(map(int, re.findall(r'The process with PID (\d+)', text))))
assert targets == [10704, 15228, 31908, 33496, 50792]
query = "$watched = @("+','.join(map(str, targets))+"); @((Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.ProcessId -in $watched -or $_.Name -like 'remaining_preparation_cost_074*' -or $_.Name -like 'performance_contract_074*' }) | Select-Object ProcessId,ParentProcessId,Name,CreationDate,ExecutablePath) | ConvertTo-Json -AsArray -Compress"
started = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
result = subprocess.run(['pwsh','-NoProfile','-NonInteractive','-Command',query],cwd=ROOT,capture_output=True,text=True,encoding='utf-8',timeout=30,check=False)
assert result.returncode == 0
observed = json.loads(result.stdout or '[]')
assert not observed, observed
record = dict(schema='hc074-read-only-owned-cleanup-postflight-v1',
    started_utc=started, finished_utc=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),
    source_commit=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],cwd=ROOT,text=True).strip(),
    packet_index_sha256=hashlib.sha256((folder/'index.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
    cleanup_log_sha256=member['sha256'], queried_pids=targets, query=query,
    exit=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout, stderr=result.stderr, observed=observed,
    all_queried_pids_absent=True, matching_test_images_absent=True,
    process_mutation=False, services_or_clocks=False, server=False,
    product_writer_retirement_proof=False, coordinator=Path(__file__).read_text())
data = (json.dumps(record,indent=2,sort_keys=True)+'\n').encode()
out = ROOT/'docs/testing/performance/0.74/local-runs/cost-phase-readers-cleanup-postflight-20261024.json'
with out.open('xb') as stream: stream.write(data)
print(json.dumps(dict(path=str(out),sha256=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),absent_pids=targets)))
